name: Kismányok (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of green and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Kismányok (a red shield with a white tree and a sun, within a wreath of vine) above a yellow scroll inscribed KISMÁNYOK.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kismányok arms with wreath and scroll
